t4.text: Instrument Grid: with the new vuu FilterBar, light and dark

fbNote.text:
FilterBar used as designed (Compact filter bar canvas): toggle with badge, Search first, quick filter fields, +N, quick-filter column chooser; toggle off shows saved filter pills.

What changes around it:
• Search replaces our Find; saved filter pills replace "Saved screens", so the scope menu is All instruments + watchlists.
• Footer shows only the filtered row count, with a filter mark while filtering.
• Buy / Sell / Depth are row actions, shown on hover and on the selected row (B / S / D).
• Each board has a Theme tweak (light/dark).

Decision (2026-11-17): the FilterBar keeps its own row; the panel header stays free for later features. A settings (gear) menu in the header shows or hides the filter bar and the footer. With the bar hidden, applied filters still filter, and the header shows a filter badge that brings the bar back.

Link column (decided earlier): one channel per instrument; linked rows can be pinned to the top via a second subscription (ric in [...]), not a server sort.

linkSpec.text:
Link column spec (works on every board in Play)

Cell states
• Not linked: empty; a link glyph shows on hover or focus.
• On a channel: a dot in the channel colour (tooltip and accessible name give the channel).
• On the active channel: the dot is ringed, like the active segment in the channel picker.
• An instrument is on one channel at most, so never more than one dot.

Link menu (click the cell)
• Lists the four channels with what each holds now: "replaces X", "empty", or "Linked · click to clear".
• Heading says "Link RIC to channel", or "Move RIC from Green to" when it is already linked; picking another channel moves it and empties the old one.
• The menu doesn't change the active channel.

Keyboard (focused row)
• Enter: link to the active channel
• 1–4: link to Red, Green, Blue, Yellow
• L: open the link menu · Esc: close it
• Double-click a row: link to the active channel

Behaviour
• Selecting a row stays local; only an explicit link publishes.
• Dots follow the workspace: they move when a channel changes anywhere.
• Link column header toggles "pin linked rows to top" (▲ when on).
